sloka: स बाणैरतिविद्धाङ्गः क्षतजेन समुक्षितः।रुधिरं प्रतिसुस्राव गिरिः प्रस्रवणं यथा ।। ६.६७.११० ।।
transliteration: sa bāṇairatividdhāṅgaḥ kṣatajena samukṣitaḥ।rudhiraṁ pratisusrāva giriḥ prasravaṇaṁ yathā ।। 6.67.110 ।।

translations.english: "Indra mounted on the elephant, Airavata surrounded by all Devatas, indeed never stood before me in conflict."
